scripts.dev: pnpm run build:web && pnpm exec wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.build:api: pnpm exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --config backend/wrangler.toml --outdir dist
scripts.build: pnpm run build:web && pnpm exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc --outdir .build/worker
scripts.check:infra: terraform -chdir=infra/cloudflare fmt -check -recursive && terraform -chdir=infra/cloudflare init -backend=false -input=false -lockfile=readonly && terraform -chdir=infra/cloudflare validate && terraform -chdir=infra/cloudflare test
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config backend/wrangler.toml --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.db:migrate:remote: pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build:web && pnpm exec wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.ci: pnpm run check:template && pnpm run db:check && pnpm run test:deploy && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
